reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, actual frozen external-01 prompt, enlarged existing source-page 14 and separate upper/lower source-note crops, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; explicitly verified TWO upper blocks AND TWO lower blocks in matching relative rows/spacing rather than rejecting a superficially blank lower page, plus hair, round glasses, upward-left pose, suit/tie, collar, backing and right-edge tab.

remaining_reasons: The original small dark right-edge note tab is not retained. The returned native right edge instead has a diagonal paper fold/notch and no compact dark tab in the original position/form. Restore the source's small dark tab and edge construction; do not substitute a crease, torn notch or different hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The note DOES retain the required four-block grouping: TWO compact upper blocks and TWO lower blocks in the next relative row, with source-consistent spacing and mostly blank remaining paper. Separate upper/lower source crops and the native return were checked; the lower pair is not missing and the superficially blank lower page is not a rejection reason. Dark-brown swept-back hair, receding hairline, short sideburns, dark brows and round dark-framed glasses remain. The face is clean-shaven with one stern downturned closed mouth, and the upward, slightly viewer-left head direction and left/up gaze are retained. The dark charcoal suit, pale-blue pointed shirt collar and dark navy tie remain without decorations. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The dark blue-charcoal backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, missing backing or working-matte ring; the right-edge tab substitution is the separate visible rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: The note glyphs themselves and fine tie weave are not readable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The authoritative two-upper/two-lower block grouping is visibly retained. The rejection depends only on the clearly different native right-edge construction, not on glyph interpretation, the blank lower page or alpha values.
